text.description_html:
Laurey 52026, Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull in Polished Chrome

The Polished Chrome Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull is ideal for traditional kitchens. The Polished Chrome finish is all at once modern and classic. This Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull in Polished Chrome comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet cup pull is part of the Laurey Nantucket Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 52026 3 Inch Pull Nantucket Polished Chrome:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 1-3/4"
  • Projection: 2"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
